items.summary: A calm way for artists, creators, managers/teams and labels to get guidance or better understand/organize automated content claims across YouTube, META & TikTok, so nothing important gets missed. Verified official sources, estimated deadline timelines, plain words. *Not expert legal advice - a guide
items.description: Use whenever a creator mentions receiving a Content ID claim, copyright claim, copyright strike, takedown, demonetization notice, muted audio, blocked upload, or rights-holder match on their own uploaded work, even if they don't name the system involved. Explains the procedural flow of automated content claims and organizes the creator's existing documentation into an evidence organizer with a deadline timeline. Tier 1 (full procedural coverage): YouTube Content ID, Meta Rights Manager (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok. Tier 2 (general guidance plus pointer to official docs): Twitch, SoundCloud. All other platforms: explain the shared DMCA layer only and direct to that platform's help center. Do NOT use for: trademark disputes, defamation, community-guideline actions unrelated to copyright, claims the user wants to file against someone else (label and distributor operators defending their own roster's uploads ARE in scope; enforcement against others is not), or any request to evade, defeat, or probe matching systems.

latestVersion.changelog:
1.0.4, More helpful & caring re-build. Inspired by Dolly Parton who moved on to the next Love Dimension last night and who donated the majority of her royalties to marginalized and at-risk-communities to center creativity, safety and imagination. https://donate.imaginationlibrary.com/

This version is a ground-up regrowth of the original guide, rebuilt around one idea: an automated claim should not get to ruin a creator or artist's day and interrupt the creative process by a whole lot of WTF and/or 'ew'. Everything below exists to hand the map back to the person holding the claim.

Every fact, verified. All deadlines, windows, strike mechanics, revenue rules, and program requirements are now live-checked against official platform sources, with dates on every citation. Where something isn't verified, the skill says so plainly instead of guessing. It never invents a date, a number, or a rule, and it tells you how sure it is when you ask.

Money, handled with care. The five-day revenue window, held earnings during disputes, payout timing, and what each choice means for your income are all explained in plain words, in your own currency as your dashboard shows it, with no invented conversions and no confident promises where the honest answer is "it depends."

Consequence maps instead of advice. The skill never tells you what to do. Instead it shows you every available path and where each one leads, with its clock and its money effect, so the choice is genuinely yours.

Your record belongs to you. The evidence organizer, the claim recap, and every summary are your files, useful for a dispute if you want one and for everything else if you don't. Continuity works through a recap you hold yourself, and nothing sensitive is ever stored.

Care for the whole ecosystem of creators. Deeper support for sampling, remix, covers, and reuse traditions. Guidance that travels well across regions, languages, connections, and ways of reading. Steady protection for young creators that trusts them and safeguards their accounts and earnings without suspicion of anyone. Warm, clear moments that name when something is serious and when it truly is not.

For managers and labels. Roster-scale triage, batch intake, shared artist summaries on your own letterhead, and cluster-level care for catalogs, so protecting many artists feels as calm as protecting one.

Grown with love by OtherPowers, as part of the Ecosystemic.ai system, which centers equitable and free human creativity as a center of gravity for humanity and for emergent tech. This is a beta release, and it will keep growing.

items.displayName: Pet Excitement Calming Guide | 宠物兴奋过度冷静引导
items.summary: AI-powered pet over-excitement detection & calming guidance. Real-time camera analysis tracks movement speed, jump height, spin laps, and jumping-on-people actions to score excitement level.
